repos.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
features: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
**Words for what you want.** "Make it pop" leaves your agent to guess. `/impeccable bolder the pricing cards` loads a playbook written for that one move and points it at one target.

**A reviewer.** `critique` scores the design against usability heuristics and ranks what to fix first. `audit` checks accessibility, performance, theming, and responsive behavior, with findings ranked P0 (blocking) to P3 (polish).
**A slop detector.** 62 deterministic rules flag the tells above, plus quality problems like cramped padding and skipped headings. No LLM, no API key.

# Impeccable

The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with `polish` and `bolder`, review with `critique` and `audit`, and catch AI slop before it ships.

From your project root:

```bash
npx impeccable install
```

Reload your coding tool, then run `/impeccable init` in your agent (`$impeccable init` on Codex).

Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Devin, Replit Agent, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, Kiro, Trae, Rovo Dev, Qoder, Mistral Vibe, Pi, Hermes Agent, DeepSeek Harness, and Veto. Full docs live at [impeccable.style/docs](https://impeccable.style/docs).

living specs today, and building its own capabilities tomorrow.

create the tools it needs based on how you actually work.

repos.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
features: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
Prompt-driven agent creation and editing on desktop and mobile, with editable instructions, avatar, and section review before saving.
Persistent agents backed by independent Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, or Cline sessions and local workspaces.
Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and custom ACP agents, with detection of local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) and installed agents.
Per-agent context monitoring with automatic compaction before long threads exhaust the model window.
FIFO message queues with pause, resume, cancellation, and crash-safe persistence.

# OpenBot

[![CI](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-PolyForm_Noncommercial_1.0.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. It supports the local
[Codex App Server](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server) and
[Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview), plus [Grok CLI](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview),
OpenCode, Gemini, [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli), and [Cline CLI](https://cline.bot/cli) through ACP. It gives every agent its own workspace and
conversation, and provides local queues, file transfers, an embedded browser, and agent-to-agent
messaging in one desktop app.

> [!WARNING]
> OpenBot is a development preview. Agents currently run with `danger-full-access` and
> `approvalPolicy: never`. They can read and modify files, run commands, use the network, and control
> the embedded browser without per-action confirmations after the explicit first-launch consent.
